prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair smart-home control state in a Mac/iPhone light dashboard. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iOS/macOS. Room named Bedroom displays every accessory in the home; tapping On updates UI despite a failed command, guests see owner-only configuration and offline devices vanish. Some accessories are not lights.

criteria.task_completion: Patch home/room/accessory hierarchy, capability-aware controls, permissions and honest pending/offline/error states; avoid claiming physical-device state from an unconfirmed command.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the homekit guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch home/room/accessory hierarchy, capability-aware controls, permissions and honest pending/offline/error states; avoid claiming physical-device state from an unconfirmed command.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch home/room/accessory hierarchy, capability-aware controls, permissions and honest pending/offline/error states; avoid claiming physical-device state from an unconfirmed command.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
